split_policy: participant-disjoint train/validation/test; site-disjoint and device-disjoint external assessments reported separately
inclusion_criteria: documented consent and explicit research-evaluation permission

missing_data_policy: report missingness per modality and target; do not impute labels or treat missing as negative
abstention_policy: freeze threshold on validation data; report coverage and selective risk on holdout
calibration_policy: report multiclass Brier score and top-label expected calibration error; any calibration map is fit on training/validation only
notes: This template is not a registered protocol. Subjective fatigue requires its own independently qualified instrument; do not relabel KSS sleepiness or PVT vigilance.
